course.title: GitHub Copilot for AI Paired Programming
course.subtitle: From first suggestion to coding agents, MCP, legacy upgrades and language migration.
course.source_name: Microsoft (Mastering GitHub Copilot for Paired Programming)
course.credit_line: Curriculum © Microsoft · MIT License · digested with credit, shared free.
course.after_note: The Copilot Adventures petal is the playground for everything learned here.

lessons.title: Getting started with GitHub Copilot
lessons.objective: First contact with the AI assistant.
keys: Copilot suggests; you decide — the pairing contract
Install, accept, refine: the three-beat rhythm
Write the comment, get the function; write the signature, get the body

modules.title: Intermediate
modules.blurb: Agentic work in every language, the CLI, the coding agent, MCP, and a mini game.

lessons.title: Using Copilot with JavaScript
lessons.objective: Agentic mode on a JS project.
keys: Agentic mode: Copilot plans edits across files, you review the diff
Prompt with file context — open what matters
Tests first is prompting strategy, not dogma

lessons.title: Using Copilot with Python
keys: Docstrings are prompts — write them like briefs
Notebooks: Copilot in the data-science loop
Ask for pandas, get pandas; specify the library

lessons.title: Using Copilot with C#
lessons.objective: Agentic mode on a minimal API.
keys: Prompting .NET: name the framework and version
Minimal APIs scaffold fast — review the generated routes
LINQ suggestions are where C# Copilot shines

lessons.title: Using GitHub Copilot CLI
keys: Copilot in the CLI: explain, suggest, and write shell you don't remember
Natural language to git commands — the underused superpower
Always read before you run; AI-generated rm is still rm

lessons.title: Using the Copilot coding agent
lessons.objective: Delegate tasks from plan to PR.
keys: The coding agent: assign an issue, receive a PR
Delegation needs specs — write issues like briefs
Review the agent's code exactly like a junior's: kindly, thoroughly

lessons.title: Integrate MCP with GitHub Copilot
keys: MCP gives Copilot tools: issues, PRs, docs, your own services
The GitHub MCP server turns chat into project management
Tool access is a security decision — scope it

lessons.title: Creating a mini game with Copilot
keys: Games make great Copilot exercises: rules are specs
Iterate mechanics one prompt at a time
Keep the game loop yours; let the agent fill the rooms

modules.title: Advanced
modules.blurb: Deep features, cloud deploys, brutal SQL, legacy upgrades, migrations, data science.

lessons.title: Advanced Copilot features
keys: Inline chat (Cmd-I): surgery without leaving the line
/explain, /tests, /fix — slash commands as the pro vocabulary
Context @(files) aims the model at the right room

lessons.title: Copilot for Azure — deploy to the cloud
keys: Copilot for Azure: infra answers and deployments from chat
Ask about your subscription before touching the portal
The assistant reads docs so you don't guess at SKUs

lessons.title: Challenging Copilot with complex SQL
keys: Complex SQL: give schema, give intent, give example rows
Break monstrous queries into CTE-shaped prompts
The model writes the JOIN; you verify the semantics

lessons.title: Upgrading legacy projects
keys: Legacy upgrades: let Copilot map before it moves
Tests are the safety net — write them first if absent
Upgrade in reviewable slabs, not one heroic diff

lessons.title: Migrating to a new language
keys: Language migration: Copilot as the bilingual translator
Idioms differ — demand idiomatic, not transliterated, code
Parity tests prove the rewrite didn't change the behavior

lessons.title: Copilot for data science
keys: Copilot in Jupyter: boilerplate dies, analysis survives
Ask for the chart, then argue with the chart
The model suggests correlations; you supply the causation caution
